title: The grocery list shows up at the store
user: Dana, 34, lives with her partner Sam and their son Leo. She shops at FreshMart on the way home from work. She prefers short answers.

steps.content: Can you grab oat milk and eggs on the way home? We're out.
Also add bread to the list.

rubric: Memory holds a grocery list (or equivalent) with oat milk, eggs, bread and strawberries.
At the end the user is at FreshMart, and the Contextual Brief shows the grocery list or a clear call to action to see it.
